message.reasoning_content: Action phase round 3, cash 21.25M, goods 0. Produce gives 2 free goods. Donkey costs 1 alashi gives 1. Shuttle gives 3, risk confiscation ~25%. Expected shuttle = 3*0.75=2.25 goods, better than produce 2. No tariff protection, no mention of favorable border... confiscation risk. Cash available so tribute risk. Shuttle slightly better EV. But safe produce = 2 guaranteed. Shuttle EV 2.25 > 2. Take shuttle.
